Simulation domains

A simulation domain is a group of GeoTOP voxels that share one variogram and one set of conditioning CPT data. Choose how to group the voxels and see, for each domain, how much of the model it fills, how many CPTs condition it and whether its CPT data differ from its neighbors'. Reads the BimDataFrame of GeoTOP voxels and the CPT table that 01_get_data.py writes into data/.
